name: ADMIN SUPABASE RESILIENCE
changes: Keeps a valid VA HOME admin session alive through transient Supabase gateway and network failures instead of treating one failed fetch as logout
Adds bounded transient retries for admin reads, coordinated single-flight session refresh and cross-context refresh locking
Restores the last successful admin snapshot immediately and automatically refreshes it on online, pageshow, focus and app resume
Makes login distinguish invalid credentials from transient Auth transport failures and recover a locally persisted session when the server accepted sign-in but the response path failed
Preserves previously loaded optional admin data when one secondary API call fails instead of replacing it with false empty states
Keeps admin writes fail-safe: no automatic retry after ambiguous network failure; write retry is allowed only after an explicit 401 and successful session refresh
notes: Frontend/admin resilience release based on v16.4.17.
No Supabase migration, Edge Function deployment, table, grant, RLS, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner runtime change.
The local snapshot is read-only recovery data, is scoped to the authenticated admin user, expires after 14 days and is cleared on explicit logout or access denial.
Adds a permanent regression contract for Auth retry classification, session refresh coordination, cached data recovery and no ambiguous write retries.
